title_en: Saturn Would Float in a Giant Bathtub #Shorts
desc_en:
Saturn has about 95 times Earth's mass, but it is spread over more than 750 times the volume. Its average density is just 0.687 g/cm3, lower than water. In a big enough bathtub it would float, though only as a thought experiment.

Sources: BBC Sky at Night; Universe Today; NASA; IFLScience.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
